All parsons interested in the aforesaid lands, There names are in the Gazette notice or not are requested to submit their claims in writing, the nature of their claims for compensation, on the day of 02.03.2017 to me at my office.

Since all person who submit their claims may call for an inquiry will informed individually to each claimant, On the due date claimant or his/her agent duly authorized by the claimant in writing should presented the inquiry and submit their claims by deeds and other documents informed by me. In addition to said documents the amount of the compensation and details of the compensa-tion should submit in two copies. If an agent present at the inquiry, he/she should submit a duly authorized letter from the original claimant without such a letter any state-ment or evidence will not be recorded at the inquiry.
